candidate.definition_en: To move quickly back and forth or up and down, or to cause something to do this.
candidate.explanation_ar: يهز حاجة جامد، زي لما تهز إزازة الدوا قبل ما تاخده، أو تهز إيد حد للسلام.

senses.definition_en: To move quickly back and forth or up and down, or to make something do this.
senses.definition_ar: يهز أو يرج شيئاً بحركات سريعة.
examples: You must shake the bottle well before use.

senses.definition_en: To hold someone's hand and move it up and down as a greeting.
examples: We shake hands whenever we greet each other.

senses.definition_en: To tremble or shiver because of cold, fear, or illness.
senses.definition_ar: يرتجف أو يرتعد من البرد أو الخوف.
examples: Cold weather can make you shake all over.
You must shake the bottle well before use.
We shake hands whenever we greet each other.
Cold weather can make you shake all over.
candidate.mnemonic: افتكر مشروب المشروب الشهير 'ميلك شيك' (Milkshake)؛ اسمه جاي من إنهم بيهزوا (shake) الحليب والمكونات جامد مع بعض علشان يمتزجوا.
